name: Contextual Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with and continues the conversation based on the given context. It evaluates if the response logically follows the previous dialogue and maintains thematic consistency.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 means not relevant at all and 5 means highly relevant.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses how engaging or interesting the response is. This includes whether it encourages further conversation, introduces new and relevant topics, or adds value to the dialogue.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 means not engaging at all and 5 means highly engaging.

name: Fact Integration
description: Evaluates how well the response incorporates the given interesting fact into the conversation. It measures if the fact is used appropriately and enhances the dialogue.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 means the fact is not integrated at all and 5 means the fact is seamlessly integrated.

name: Grammar and Coherence
description: Assesses the grammatical correctness and coherence of the response. A coherent response is easy to read and understand, with correct grammar and sentence structure.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 means poor grammar and coherence and 5 means excellent grammar and coherence.

name: Personality and Tone
description: Measures the consistency of the response's tone with the established tone in the dialogue. It also evaluates if the response maintains a consistent personality for the character, if applicable.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 means inconsistent personality or tone and 5 means consistent personality and tone.
